comment: The known Azure Monitor Agent regression (azure-integration.md): per-drive InstanceName collapses to '_Total' instead of the individual drive letters, for a resource whose per-volume free-space figures were requested. Contrast with logs_logical_disk_free_space.json, whose rows carry a real drive letter ('C:') -- this recording is what the metrics collector must turn into an instance_name_collapsed gap naming the resource and the counter, emitting NO per-volume free-space value for that resource, rather than reporting '_Total' as though it were one real, whole-VM volume. Two rows are included, both collapsed, to rule out an implementation that only checks the first row.
